facts.fact: 一瘦光出现在海平线上；他先看见，说是一艘货轮
从她游上岛算起已经七个月，这段时间他们没见过任何船与陆地
facts.anchor: It’s been seven months since I swam to the island

facts.fact: 她在石圈里搭好引火柴，只差一个火种，Clay 站着不动
facts.anchor: “I need a flame!” I say, panic choking my throat.

facts.fact: 他问她想要什么，并说不会怪她离开
facts.anchor: I winnae blame ye for leaving

facts.fact: 她提议一起走，他说自己不属于那个世界、那个时代
facts.anchor: I dinnae belong in that world anymore.

facts.fact: 她求他告诉她该怎么做，他说「Ye know I can’t. Ye already know what I want.」
facts.anchor: Ye know I can’t. Ye already know what I want.

facts.fact: 她想起 Nana 在车道上说的「去找你的岛」「鲁莽一次」
facts.anchor: Go find your island, she said in the driveway

facts.fact: 她把手里的引火柴扔在地上
facts.anchor: I drop the piece of kindling in my hand.

facts.fact: 她说「I don’t care about the ship… I don’t want my old life. I want this one.」
facts.anchor: I don’t want my old life. I want this one.

facts.fact: 他把她抱进屋，两人没到卧室，停在沙发上
facts.anchor: We don’t make it to the bedroom. The couch is as far as we get.
